justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures with frontal faces and incorporate circular disc motifs on or near the body, but this is about as generic as figural iconography gets. A shows a single static, blocky standing figure with schematic incised discs and hanging hair, while B shows a mirror-symmetric pair of active profile-faced figures flanking a central pole, holding rattles and shields, with elaborate headdresses, kilts and sandals — no shared specific attributes, relationships or compositional scheme.
